chunks: He will teach him the Book and the Wisdom, and the Torah and the Gospel,

key_terms.الْكِتَابَ: The Book, referring to scripture or the Quran
key_terms.والتَّوْرَاةَ: And the Torah, the scripture revealed to Moses
key_terms.وَالْإِنْجِيلَ: And the Gospel, the scripture revealed to Jesus
key_terms.وَالْحِكْمَةَ: And the Wisdom, denoting deep understanding and insight

ai.seo_question: What did Jesus (Isa) teach according to this Quranic verse?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse underscores the comprehensive nature of Jesus's (Isa, AS) prophetic mission, where 'Al-Kitab' is often interpreted as the Quran or a specific revealed book, while 'Al-Hikmah' denotes deep spiritual insight and 'At-Tawrah wa Al-Injil' refer to the previous scriptures he confirmed and taught. This divine instruction highlights his role not merely as a messenger but as a teacher of both exoteric law and esoteric wisdom to the Children of Israel, bridging the gap between earlier revelations and the final truth.
